aToB.memory: Finn still winces fondly at the memory of Headmistress Sterling calmly catching him halfway up the campus clocktower hunting an aerial orientation photo—the exact moment he swore off ever hearing 'Finnian' in polite company. Though her gracious Grand Athenaeum responses turn every press question into diplomatic mist, he genuinely admires how fiercely she shields Yozakura's students.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Finn wants to catch Headmistress Sterling politely outside the Grand Athenaeum for an official quote on autumn enrollment and Mooncrest festivities, quietly testing whether she drops any clue about those visiting Ministry dispatches.

bToA.memory: Aurelia remembers escorting an ink-stained Finnian Reed down from the clocktower ledge with quiet amusement beneath her formal reprimand. She welcomes a spirited student paper that challenges campus complacency, yet keeps a calm protective eye on his press pass so he doesn't accidentally hand visiting Ministry bureaucrats a headline about irregular Earth thresholds.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Aurelia wants to greet Finnian graciously in the Grand Athenaeum, compliment his lively coverage of student club life, and softly remind him that unverified rumors about external inspections rarely serve anyone's safety.
